statement: ∀ (T : ℝ), 0 < T → DiscreteTopology ↑(range fun k => ↑k * T)
script:
# name: set-multiples-discrete-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Subspace.multiples_discrete
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T), DiscreteTopology (range (fun k : ℤ => (k : ℝ) * T)) := by
  intro T hT
  refine DiscreteTopology.of_forall_le_dist hT ?_
  rintro ⟨x, k, rfl⟩ ⟨y, l, rfl⟩ hxy
  have hkl : k ≠ l := fun h => hxy (by subst h; rfl)
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, ← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hT]
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ) - l| := by
    rw [← Int.cast_sub, ← Int.cast_abs]
    exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 hkl)
  nlinarith
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['2 * Real.pi', '(by positivity)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T), DiscreteTopology (range (fun k : ℤ => (k : ℝ) * T)) := by
  intro T hT
  refine DiscreteTopology.of_forall_le_dist hT ?_
  rintro ⟨x, k, rfl⟩ ⟨y, l, rfl⟩ hxy
  have hkl : k ≠ l := fun h => hxy (by subst h; rfl)
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, ← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hT]
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ) - l| := by
    rw [← Int.cast_sub, ← Int.cast_abs]
    exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 hkl)
  nlinarith
exact @key (2 * Real.pi) ((by positivity))'),
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T), DiscreteTopology (range (fun k : ℤ => (k : ℝ) * T)) := by
  intro T hT
  refine DiscreteTopology.of_forall_le_dist hT ?_
  rintro ⟨x, k, rfl⟩ ⟨y, l, rfl⟩ hxy
  have hkl : k ≠ l := fun h => hxy (by subst h; rfl)
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, ← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hT]
  have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ) - l| := by
    rw [← Int.cast_sub, ← Int.cast_abs]
    exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 hkl)
  nlinarith
exact @key (1/2) ((by norm_num))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
